description: This file implements a Service Worker for handling trace data loading, snapshot serving, and resource management in a web-based trace viewer. It manages trace loading, caching, and fetch event handling, including special routes for trace snapshots, context info, and resource retrieval.

classes.name: Client
classes.description: Represents a client with an ID, URL, and a method to post messages.

classes.name: ServiceWorkerGlobalScope
classes.description: Type definition for the global scope of the service worker, including event listeners and client management.

classes.name: LoadedTrace
classes.description: Holds the trace loader and snapshot server instances for a loaded trace.

methods.name: simulateRestart
methods.description: Clears cached traces and client trace URL mappings to simulate a service worker restart.

methods.name: loadTraceOrError
methods.description: Attempts to load a trace and returns either the loaded trace or an error response.

methods.name: loadTrace
methods.description: Loads a trace given a client ID and URL, caching the result.

methods.name: innerLoadTrace
methods.description: Performs the actual trace loading process, including error handling and snapshot server setup.

methods.name: doFetch
methods.description: Handles fetch events, routing requests to appropriate trace data or static resources.

methods.name: downloadHeaders
methods.description: Creates headers for file download responses based on URL search parameters.

methods.name: gc
methods.description: Performs garbage collection of cached traces and client mappings.

methods.name: clientProgress
methods.description: Creates a progress callback that posts progress messages to a client.

methods.name: isLiveTrace
methods.description: Determines if a trace URI points to a live trace based on URL parameters.
